items: Latest Android 15 & Powerful Performance - Experience the upgraded Android 15 system for enhanced privacy and a smoother UI. Driven by a robust Octa-Core Unisoc T606 processor, this tablet handles multitasking with ease, perfect for switching between professional apps and high-definition streaming.

Massive 20GB RAM & 128GB Expandable Storage - Eliminate lag with 20GB RAM (6GB Physical + 14GB Virtual) for fluid workflows. Store all your essential files and media on 128GB internal storage, with the flexibility to expand up to 2TB via Micro SD—offering more space than many laptops in its class.

Immersive 11" Display & Long-Lasting Battery - Enjoy crisp visuals on the 11-inch IPS touchscreen with a 16:9 cinematic ratio for work or play. The 8000mAh battery with 18W Fast Charging (USB-C) ensures reliable endurance for travel, study, or extended entertainment sessions.

Complete 2-in-1 Productivity Bundle - Instantly transform your tablet into a workstation with the included Bluetooth keyboard, wireless mouse, protective case, and stylus. It’s the ideal all-in-one solution for students and professionals needing a laptop-like experience on the go.

High-Speed WiFi 6 & Versatile Connectivity - Stay connected with ultra-fast 2.4G/5Ghz Dual-Band WiFi 6 for stable video calls and gaming. Featuring a 3.5mm headphone jack, GPS, and Bluetooth 5.0, this tablet is a versatile companion for work, travel, and daily entertainment.
